item.description: Annapolis, Md. — Maryland State Administrator of Elections Jared DeMarinis issued a statement February 6, 2026, addressing recent claims and press statements suggesting the potential nationalization of election administration, including in Maryland, and clarifying the legal framework governing elections in the state.
